framework.name: PCI DSS
framework.full_name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard

requirements.title: Install and maintain network security controls
Apply secure configurations to all system components
Protect cardholder data with strong cryptography
Restrict access to system components and cardholder data
Log and monitor all access to system components

failing_controls.title: PAN is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored
failing_controls.description: Primary Account Number (PAN) must be encrypted at rest

failing_assets.issue: S3 bucket default encryption not enabled

failing_controls.remediation: Enable encryption at rest for all data stores containing PAN

failing_controls.title: Strong cryptography and security protocols are implemented
failing_controls.description: Ensure TLS 1.2 or higher is used for cardholder data transmission
failing_controls.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1, enforce TLS 1.2 minimum

failing_controls.title: Configuration standards are defined and implemented
failing_controls.description: Network security controls must be properly configured
failing_controls.remediation: Restrict database security group to only allow known application servers

failing_controls.title: Access is assigned based on job classification and function

failing_assets.issue: Overprivileged - can access cardholder data environment

failing_controls.remediation: Implement least-privilege IAM policies based on job function

failing_controls.title: Audit logs capture all individual user access
failing_controls.description: All user access to cardholder data must be logged

failing_assets.issue: Application logs not forwarded to centralized logging

failing_controls.remediation: Configure CloudWatch agent to forward all access logs

recommendations.action: Enable encryption for customer-db-prod and payment-data-archive
recommendations.impact: Addresses 2 critical control failures in Requirement 3

recommendations.action: Restrict database security group to application tier only
Review and right-size IAM permissions for all roles
